history.origins: England. Competitive patience; single-deck version of Russian Bank. Shared four foundations (Ace up in suit) and four tableau columns. Name 'Chinese' is exotic only.
timeline: English origin; related to Russian Bank
First to run out of cards wins

setup.deck: 52 cards, no Jokers. Rank K down to A for building.
setup.dealing: Four cards dealt to centre as tableau (face down, turned by first player); remainder dealt equally to players as face-down stocks.
setup.equipment: 52-card deck; space for 4 foundations, 4 tableau columns, each player's stock and waste.

rules.objective: Be the first to get rid of all your cards by building on the four shared foundations (Ace up in suit), the four tableau columns (down in alternating colour or by local rule), or on other players' waste piles.
rules.gameplay: Turns clockwise. Build foundations up in suit from Aces; build tableau down (Kâ€“A). Move cards from stock to waste; build from tableau or waste to foundations or other waste. First to empty hand wins.
keyRules: Build foundations up in suit; tableau down
Can play onto other players' waste piles; first out wins
